answer: Stop sybils with a vault violet zenith: an agent stakes a bond for one vault. Each cycle at zenith a sunbeam crosses its skylight and strikes a violet tile; verifiers match its glow spot to the vault notch, voiding a vault whose spot is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 vaults at 17x: each beam hits one vault at one zenith, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents open once, keep rights.
